def analyze(k):
    I=G[k+' input']
    H=len(I);Wd=len(I[0]);seen=[[False]*Wd for _ in range(H)]
    objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(Wd):
            if seen[r][c] or I[r][c]==0 or I[r][c]==5: continue
            col=I[r][c];cells=[];st=[(r,c)]
            while st:
                x,y=st.pop()
                if (x,y) in cells or I[x][y]!=col:continue
                cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<Wd and not seen[nx][ny] and I[nx][ny]==col:
                        st.append((nx,ny))
            rs=[x for x,_ in cells];cs=[y for _,y in cells]
            side='a' if max(rs)<5 else 'b'
            objs.append(dict(side=side,col=col,r0=min(rs),r1=max(rs),c0=min(cs),c1=max(cs),n=len(cells),cells=cells))

G=load()
def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    objs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==0: continue
            st=[(i,j)];c=[]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                if (y,x) in seen_set:=set() or g[y][x]!=v: continue
                seen_set.add((y,x)); c.append((y,x))
                st+=[(y+dy,x+dx) for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1)]
            ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
            key=(min(ys),min(xs))
            objs.append((v,key,len(c),c))
    # remove color 2 and full-width bars (rows entirely that color spanning width)
    objs=[o for o in objs if o[0]!=2 and not all(x==o[0] for x in row for row in [g[o[1][0]]])]
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(o[1],o[2]))  # asc minrow, tie mincol
    # anchor bottom-most at original position; stack upward flush-left
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=None
    for v,(_,_),sz,c in reversed(objs):
        if cur is None:
            cur=(v,(_,_),sz,c)
            continue
        # place this shape directly above cur, flush left
        cy=min(y for y,x in cur[2]); cx=min(x for y,x in cur[2])
        ch=max(y for y,x in c)-min(y for y,x in c)+1; cw=max(x for y,x in c)-min(x for y,x in c)+1
        top=cy-ch
        for dy,dx in c:
            y,x=top+dy,cx+dx
            if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W: out[y][x]=v
    return out

    print(json.dumps(pred)); print(json.dumps(exp))

def comps(grid,v):
    H=len(grid);W=len(grid[0]);seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]==v and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or grid[y][x]!=v: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); c.append((y,x))
                    st+=[(y+dy,x+dx) for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1)]
                ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
                out.append((sorted(c),min(ys),min(xs)))
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bar color (full row) and marker color (single scattered color != background)
    bar=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0: bar=g[i][0]; break
    comps={}
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==0 or c==bar or seen[i][j]: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                if seen[y][x]: continue
                seen[y][x]=True; cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==c and not seen[ny][nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
            comps.setdefault(c,[]).append(cells)
    # marker: the color whose components are small & scattered (not among big object colors); here take non-bar color with fewer than 10 cells total
    small=max(((sum(len(c) for cc in v) for c,v in comps.items()), key=lambda x:-x)) if False else None
    obj_colors={c for c in comps if sum(len(cc) for cc in v)>8 for v in [comps[c]]}
    mc=[c for c in comps if c not in obj_colors and c!=bar][0]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    objs=[]
    for c in obj_colors:
        cells=comps[c]
        # dedupe: keep component with largest min row (lowest occurrence) among duplicates
        best=max(cells,key=lambda cl:min(y for y,_ in cl))
        objs.append(best)
    objs.sort(key=lambda cl:min(x for _,x in cl))  # leftmost first
    base=min(min(y for _,_ in o) for o in objs)
    for k,(cl,) in enumerate([(o,) for o in objs]):
        pass
    # slide each object vertically until it touches (adjacent) the one above / stack flush at top
    placed=[]
    cur_r=base
    for cl in objs:
        h=max(y for y,_ in cl)-min(y for y,_ in cl)+1
        w=max(x for _,x in cl)-min(x for _,x in cl)+1
        # move object so its top is at cur_r, keeping columns
        top=min(y for y,_ in cl)
        sh=cur_r-top
        cells=[(y+sh,x) for y,x in cl]
        placed.append((cells,w)); cur_r+=h
    for k,(cells,w) in enumerate(placed):
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=obj_colors[k]
    return out

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cs=comps(I)
    # marker = color whose cells are few scattered? identify: color 2 in demo = the scattered small multi-cell; bar = full-width row
    bar=None; mcol=None
    for c,cl in cs:
        rs=[y for y,_ in cl]; rcs={y}
        if len(set(rs))==1 and len(cl)==W: bar=(c,cl[0][0])
        elif len(cl)<=8 and len(set(y for y,_ in cl))<=4 and len(set(x for _,x in cl))<=4: mcol=c
    barc,barrow=bar
    objs=[(c,cl) for c,cl in cs if c not in (barc,mcol)]
    # dedupe by normalized shape, keep lower occurrence
    seen={}
    kept=[]
    for c,cl in objs:
        sh=tuple(sorted((y-min(y for y,_ in cl),x-min(x for _,x in cl)) for y,x in cl))
        key=(sh,c)
        if key not in seen: seen[key]=(c,cl,sh)
        else:
            cy=min(y for y,_ in cl); ox=min(x for _,x in cl)
            prev_c,prev_cl,_=seen[key]
            # keep lower: compare original positions? keep the one with larger min row
            if cy>min(y for y,_ in prev_cl): seen[key]=(c,cl,sh)
    # reorder: primary key leftmost column asc? in demo: 1-shape col8, 7s col8-10 -> 1 first, then 7s aligned. order by leftmost col asc
    items=[]
    for c,cl,sh in seen.values():
